entries.title: King of Norway's health has worsened, palace says
entries.summary: Norway's King Harald remains in hospital receiving antibiotics for a bloodstream bacterial infection.

entries.summary_zh: 挪威国王哈拉尔因血液细菌感染仍在医院接受抗生素治疗。

entries.title: France links sharp rise in drownings to heatwaves
entries.summary: A government minister says people have been taking risks by going into the water, with 301 deaths since 19 June.
entries.title_zh: 法国将溺水人数急剧上升与热浪联系起来
entries.summary_zh: 一位政府部长表示，人们一直冒险跳入水中，自 6 月 19 日以来已有 301 人死亡。

entries.title: Trump waves green flag to start IndyCar race through Washington streets
entries.summary: The president took a ceremonial lap of the track before the race, which is the culmination of a summer of events to mark the country's 250th birthday.
entries.title_zh: 特朗普挥舞绿旗在华盛顿街头开始印地赛车比赛
entries.summary_zh: 总统在比赛前在赛道上绕了一圈，这是整个夏天纪念该国 250 岁生日活动的高潮。

entries.title: Salah scores first two Trabzonspor goals
entries.summary: Mohamed Salah scores twice on his first Turkish Super Lig start for Trabzonspor - and almost has a hat-trick - as they beat Istanbul Basaksehir.
entries.title_zh: 萨拉赫为特拉布宗体育队前两粒进球
entries.summary_zh: 穆罕默德·萨拉赫在特拉布宗体育队首次在土耳其超级联赛首发中梅开二度，并且差点上演帽子戏法，帮助球队击败伊斯坦布尔巴萨克谢希尔。
